subject.title: Bug: Cron fallback chain broken — models return zero-token success or killed by shared AbortController

question: Should maintainers keep this broad issue open for fresh current-main/release evidence on the remaining abort-deadline and session-persistence symptoms, or close it now as fixed enough by #100483 and route deadline-budget work through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/52365?
rationale: Automation can prove the empty-result classifier fix on current main, but the remaining symptoms depend on whether the outer cron deadline behavior is accepted as contract and whether fresh post-fix session-state evidence appears.

options.title: Keep Open For Fresh Evidence
options.body: Leave this issue open until a reporter or maintainer provides current-main/release logs for the remaining abort or session-persistence symptom, while #52365 handles the narrower budget-gate proposal.

options.title: Close As Fixed Enough
options.body: Close this issue now if maintainers accept the outer deadline behavior as intended and do not want the broad combined report to remain open without fresh post-fix evidence.

options.title: Replace With Narrow Issue
options.body: Close this broad issue only after opening or confirming a narrower issue for the still-current deadline-budget or session-persistence symptom.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Fresh Evidence
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until a reporter or maintainer provides current-main/release logs for the remaining abort or session-persistence symptom, while #52365 handles the narrower budget-gate proposal.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete landed the classifier fix and wrote the current issue comment defining what evidence would change the remaining decision.
